It shows reconnect, already-finished/failed edge cases, then initial/in-progress/finished/error steps; the start button dispatches backupDeviceThunk (BackupStep1Initial.tsx:61). Same capability as the deferred-backup feature.

Reached from Settings > Device Check backup (CheckRecoverySeed.tsx:22), the firmware check-seed step when the device is backed up (StepCheckSeed.tsx:130), and rerunRecoveryThunk for an initialized device in recovery mode (onboardingActions.ts:308 via PrerequisitesGuide/DeviceRecoveryMode.tsx:27). Model One adds word-count, recovery-type, PIN matrix and in-Suite word entry steps.

findings: Desktop foreground app opened by handleProtocolRequestThunk when Suite desktop receives the trezorsuite://bridge-requested-by-a-3rd-party deeplink (protocolActions.ts:70-73). Suite web sends that deeplink from useOpenSuiteDesktop, which is the trigger of connection.bridge, not a control on this screen. The screen explains that another app requested Suite. It offers Keep running in background (desktopApi.appHide), a Take me back to wallet confirmation and an embedded Auto start control (the same control as Settings > Application > Trezor Connect). It exits to the wallet automatically when a Connect popup call starts. On web the component renders only ErrorPage.

findings: Renders the device/wallet switcher (SwitchDevice) when the preferred modal is the switch-device foreground app; ForegroundAppModal maps 'switch-device' to null because rendering moved here. Reached via Alt+W, add-wallet, passphrase modal, Connect popup switch-device and first device disconnect with accounts.

uncertainties.detail: Every assigned page wrapper has an explicit disposition. Supporting-component rows identify inspected user-control excerpts. This static audit does not prove all dynamic device/provider/network branches or runtime reachability, and is not exhaustive call-graph review.
Connect silent-mode checkbox and settings item both require debug mode. Active E2E verifies focus suppression, but this is not added as an ordinary user feature.
Debug label wipe excluded. Actual normal-user relay settings are exposed by LabelingSettings > SuiteSyncServers, so existing relay feature remains valid.
Product-team attribution for additions is inferred by domain, not confirmed responsibility.
Resolved: native PassphraseDuplicateAlert switches to the existing wallet but does not expose the desktop modal retry action.
